name: Modern Earth
description: d20 Modern's own core rulebook ships with NO canonical setting of its own — it's built to run "our world," with the GM dialing the tone anywhere from grounded, gun-and-badge realism to summer-blockbuster action. The official genre lines that DO have their own fixed premise (Urban Arcana's fantasy creatures hiding in plain sight, Shadow Chasers' hidden supernatural war, Agents of Psi's psionic espionage) are optional expansions layered on top, not what this baseline represents. This Setting is a single, honestly-labeled EXAMPLE of that baseline assumption — present-day Earth, real geography, real headlines, ordinary people who get pulled into extraordinary trouble — not official canon, because the core game deliberately has none.
